column3: “Things of this” expands world; “not dependent on them” replaces not using fully.
“Work” specifies the things of the Lord.
“His interests” supplies a subject for is divided; “or” replaces and between woman and virgin.
The image of throwing a noose is replaced by “restrict.”
“Betrothed” interprets his virgin; “they ought to marry” specifies it ought to be so.
“Not to marry” interprets keeping his own virgin.
“To her husband” is supplied; “dies” replaces falls asleep; “as long as he belongs to the Lord” expands only in the Lord.
